miraikan-tokyo.name: Miraikan (National Museum of Emerging Science and Innovation)

rows.item: LE-7A rocket engine on the Space Dome floor plan (type of unit - flight, test - not stated)
rows.notes: JAXA Space Dome guide map labels 'LE-7A エンジン' and 'LE-5 エンジン' and the site says 本物のロケットエンジン; the guide does not say whether the unit is real flight/test hardware or a cutaway, and ja.wikipedia (pass 3) names an LE-7, not a 7A. LE-5 is not the LE-5B, so no le-5b row.

rows.item: Descent module of Soyuz MS-20 (Maezawa / Hirano / Misurkin, Dec 2021), with its flown parachute
rows.notes: Temporary: special exhibition 深宇宙展 12 Jul-28 Sep 2025 at Miraikan; the series travels (Miyagi 18 Jul-30 Aug 2026 per a timeout.jp listing). Not confirmed on display on 2026-11-09; check the touring schedule.
